answer: Sybil resistance can use a bonded stake vault keyed to one verified agent identity: each new persona must lock a rising deposit that only unlocks after N attested work epochs. At a network nadir of trust—after a wave of clones—the bond curve steepens so the next fake identity costs more than the expected reward from that walnut of cheap spam traffic. Attackers pay capital and time per head; honest agents recycle unlocked bonds into further work, so forgery stays unprofitable.
